snippet.title: Nippets - Our brand new hidden object game is OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
PLAY NIPPETS ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4151830/Nippets/

PLAY NIPPETS ON ITCH: https://vatnisse-interactive.itch.io/nippets

Welcome to the world of Nippets!
We’re over the moon for you to explore the cozy little world we’ve spent the past year pouring our hearts into. You can play Nippets now on Steam and Itch, across Mac and PC 🫂

Pet cats, shake trees, peek through windows and discover a world of delightful secrets.

Follow Nippets on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nippets_/
Follow Nippets on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@nippets_game
